show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Joel Greenblatt – Common Sense for Value at Gotham Capital
summary: Our conversation takes a tour through Joel's career. We cover his background, early success running a concentrated portfolio, closing of the fund to manage his own money, and re-opening with a more diversified approach. We discuss Joel's timeless investment beliefs and along the way also discuss the Value Investors Club, seeding managers, and applying investment lessons to education.
